content_units: Here’s a two-day listening plan built around your taste: neo-soul, jazz rap, alternative R&B, and mellow electronic, with deeper cuts over obvious names. I’ve avoided the most standard gateway picks and grouped 12 lesser-known artists by mood so the weekend flows naturally.
1.   Raveena   — soft psychedelic R&B with featherlight vocals
2.   Sohn   — moody electronic soul with elegant tension
3.   Jordan Rakei   — jazz-informed soul with warm, intricate production
- Starter songs:   Eye to Eye  ,   Sorceress
4.   Awon   — relaxed, thoughtful jazz rap with underground warmth
- Starter songs:   Sleep Is the Cousin  ,   Blood Drive
5.   Anti-Lilly & Phoniks   — classic-minded boom bap with soulful loops
- Starter songs:   Stories From the Brass Section  ,   Timeless
6.   Loyle Carner   — conversational, introspective rap over mellow jazz textures
- Starter songs:   Ottolenghi  ,   The Isle of Arran
7.   Mereba   — earthy alternative R&B with folk-soul calm
8.   Kadhja Bonet   — art-pop soul with cinematic, spiritual depth
- Starter songs:   Remember the Rain  ,   Delphine
9.   Moonchild   — silky nu-jazz and soul with immaculate restraint
10.   Tourist   — emotional, understated electronic music with glow rather than drop-heavy payoff
11.   Jitwam   — dusty funk, lo-fi soul, and left-field groove in one pocket
12.   Space Captain   — fluid alternative soul with jazz phrasing and cosmic softness
-   Afternoon:   Jordan Rakei, Kadhja Bonet, Space Captain
-   Evening wind-down:   Anti-Lilly & Phoniks, then return to your 2-3 favorite discoveries
Best First 4 If You Want the Highest Hit Rate
Option 1:   Moonchild     Closest to your jazz-soul sweet spot without feeling predictable   Smoothest entry point
Option 2:   Jordan Rakei     Rich musicianship, soulful vocals, and subtle groove   Best all-round fit
Option 3:   Anti-Lilly & Phoniks     Excellent if your Nujabes side wants more lyrical jazz-hop   Strongest rap pick
Option 4:   Tourist     Best mellow electronic crossover for night listening   Most atmospheric pick
